data.heading: About your donation
data.subheading: We want you to feel confident about where your gift goes.

items.question: Where does my money go?
items.answer: Eighty-four pence of every pound goes directly to clean water projects. The rest covers fundraising and administration.

items.question: Is my donation tax deductible?
items.answer: Yes. Brightwell is a registered charity and you will receive a receipt by email straight after giving.

items.question: Can I give monthly?
items.answer: Monthly gifts help us plan ahead. You can pause, change or cancel at any time with one email.

items.question: Will I hear how it was used?
items.answer: Supporters receive a twice-yearly impact report with photos and stories from the villages we work in.
